beats.headline: Two satchels in the pouch
beats.text: Prison Pocket, a level-170 gatekeeper, blocks the road, and Carl's plan goes through his pouch. Carl, dressed as a joey, prepares two hobgoblin big boom satchels in his inventory and hops. Stuffed into the pouch face-first, he claws his way to the bottom and releases both satchels, which start to degrade quickly. He presses his feet against the inside, hops as he activates Gloom Wraith Phase, and hits the detonator in midair. He lands rolling on the asphalt while ice and kangaroo bits rain down round him.
